judgments.rationale: The proposed edit correctly and completely incorporates the governing prerequisites from paragraphs (1) through (4) that condition the agency head's authority to collect by administrative offset. It faithfully preserves the statutory standard that paragraph (4) requires providing an opportunity to make a written agreement rather than requiring actual execution of an agreement.

The proposal misstates paragraph (4) by describing it as 'execution by the debtor of a written agreement', whereas the source text requires only giving the debtor 'an opportunity to make a written agreement'.

Retaining the unchanged draft statement is unsupported because the summary fails to include the governing conditions specified in the source text that administrative offset may occur only after giving the debtor the notice and opportunities set forth in paragraphs (1) through (4).
